assessments.zone: Kindu city: communes of Kindu/Kasuku and Alunguli, all health-area neighbourhoods (Lwama, Tokolote, Mikelenge, Rva, Brazza, Lumbulumbu, Kasuku 1-2, Basoko, Trois Z, Katako, Alunguli, Kama 2, Sokolo, Mangobo, Kamikunga, Mizeituni, Mikonde, Kasenga)
assessments.evidence: Provincial capital with full state administration, police and an FARDC garrison; no armed group is reported to hold or tax any part of the city. Day-to-day order and arrests are handled by the PNC. Research for this unit could not be performed (tools blocked), so this rests on default state presence.

assessments.zone: Peri-urban villages of Kindu ville outside the urban core (Non/Kimbangu, Lokala, Faba, Odimba, Lwama villages, Tomenga, Matungulu 7 Km)
assessments.evidence: Villages within a few km of the provincial capital with no reported armed-group activity; assumed under the police/administration of Kindu ville. Not verified by recent reporting.

units.CD6301-kindu: Kindu is the capital of Maniema province, far west of the eastern Kivu frontlines, and has no reported armed-group control. The city (communes of Kindu, Kasuku and Alunguli) is policed by the PNC with a substantial FARDC garrison (regional military command, airport base) and ANR/provincial institutions present. Peri-urban villages around the city (Lwama, Lokala, Odimba, Tomenga, Matungulu 7 Km, etc.) are assumed to be under the same state police presence. Web research for this unit was blocked (search budget exhausted, news sites egress-blocked), so the assessment rests on default state presence and background knowledge; confidence is limited accordingly.
